entities.summary:
Per H. Enflo is a Swedish mathematician working primarily in functional analysis, a field in which he solved problems that had been considered fundamental. Three of these problems had been open for more than forty years:The basis problem and the approximation problem and later
the invariant subspace problem for Banach spaces.
